datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC acute food insecurity phase classifications were collected by FEWS NET field enumerators on a regular schedule (approximately monthly) and spatially attributed to administrative or livelihood zone polygons across Burkina Faso. The data represent near-term projected scenarios for January, April, July, and October 2011, encoded as GeoJSON and KML geographic files with associated IPC phase values and scenario metadata.
